earnings.title: Contacts: Tracey Noe (Media) Shep Dunlap (Investors)
highlights: Adjusted EPS was $0.78 which increased +5.5% on a constant currency basis

quotes.text: We delivered strong third-quarter results, driven by broad based volume growth and robust share performance. We continue to see top- and bottom-line growth momentum across both developed and emerging markets, while significantly reinvesting in our brands, innovation, and distribution.
quotes.by: Dirk Van de Put, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer

outlook: For 2026, the company reaffirms Organic Net Revenue growth of at least 2 percent and Adjusted EPS growth in the range of flat to 5 percent on a constant currency basis.
The company also expects 2026 Free Cash Flow of approximately $3 billion.

items.heading: Commodity and other input prices are volatile and may increase or decrease significantly or availability of commodities may become constrained.
We are subject to risks from operating globally, including potential cost impacts of any tariffs that may be enacted by governments as well as other trade and regulatory uncertainty.
We are subject to risks from changes to the trade policies and tariff and import/export regulations by the U.S. and/or other foreign governments.
The war in Ukraine has impacted and could continue to impact our business operations, financial performance and results of operations.

We operate in a highly competitive industry where we face risks related to the execution of our strategy as well as our ability or willingness to respond, timely or otherwise, to channel shifts, pricing and other competitive pressures.
Our operations in certain emerging markets expose us to political, economic and regulatory risks.
